text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerjaan Sendiri (Kadar Caruman bagi Pemandu Kenderaan

E-Hailing) 2018.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 November 2018.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Peraturan-Peraturan ini—

"kenderaan e-hailing" mempunyai erti yang diberikan kepadanya di bawah

seksyen 2 Akta Lembaga Pelesenan Kenderaan Perdagangan 1987 [Akta 334];

"pemandu kenderaan e-hailing" ertinya mana-mana orang bekerja

sendiri yang—

(a) menjalankan aktiviti pekerjaan sendiri sebagaimana yang dinyatakan

dalam butiran 1 Jadual Pertama kepada Akta;

(b) mempunyai lesen memandu yang sah yang dikeluarkan di bawah

seksyen 26 Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987 [Akta 333]; dan

(c) bagi maksud perenggan (a), telah dikeluarkan baginya—

(i) suatu lesen vokasional yang sah di bawah seksyen 56

Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987 oleh Pengarah bagi

Pengangkutan Jalan; dan

(ii) suatu kad pemandu atau kad pemandu elektronik yang sah

di bawah kaedah 10A Kaedah-Kaedah Kenderaan Motor

(Pengangkutan Perdagangan) 1959 [L.N. 175/1959] oleh

Suruhanjaya Pengangkutan Awam Darat atau Lembaga

Pelesenan Kenderaan Perdagangan.

Kadar caruman

3. (1) Tiap-tiap pemandu kenderaan e-hailing hendaklah membayar suatu

caruman kepada Pertubuhan atau mana-mana ejen keselamatan sosial pekerjaan

sendiri pada kadar sebagaimana yang dipilih oleh pemandu kenderaan e-hailing itu

berdasarkan Pendapatan Bulanan Pilihan yang Diinsuranskan sebagaimana yang

dinyatakan dalam Jadual.

(2) Tempoh pelindungan bagi kadar caruman yang dipilih oleh pemandu

kenderaan e-hailing di bawah subperaturan (1) hendaklah bagi tempoh dua belas bulan

berturut-turut.

(3) Jika dalam tempoh pelindungan yang disebut dalam subperaturan (2)

kesahan lesen vokasional yang dikeluarkan kepada pemandu kenderaan e-hailing

di bawah seksyen 56 Akta Pengangkutan Jalan 1987, atau kad pemandu atau kad

pemandu elektronik yang dikeluarkan kepada pemandu kenderaan e-hailing di bawah

kaedah 10A Kaedah-Kaedah Kenderaan Motor (Pengangkutan Perdagangan) 1959,

habis tempoh—

(a) tempoh pelindungan itu hendaklah terus berkuat kuasa sehingga tempoh

dua belas bulan berturut-turut itu habis; dan

(b) pemandu kenderaan e-hailing itu hendaklah mengemukakan kepada

Pertubuhan, apabila diminta oleh Pertubuhan, lesen vokasional,

kad pemandu atau kad pemandu eletronik baharunya, mengikut

mana-mana yang berkenaan, untuk penentusahan.

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2017

SELF-EMPLOYMENT SOCIAL SECURITY

(RATES OF CONTRIBUTION FOR E-HAILING VEHICLE DRIVER) REGULATIONS 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 10 and paragraph 83(2)(h) of the

Self-Employment Social Security Act 2017 [Act 789], the Minister makes the

following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Self-Employment Social Security

(Rates of Contribution for E-Hailing Vehicle Driver) Regulations 2018.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 1 November 2018.

Interpretation

2. In these Regulations—

"e-hailing vehicle" has the meaning assigned to it under section 2 of the

Commercial Vehicles Licensing Board Act 1987 [Act 334];

"e-hailing vehicle driver" means any self-employed person who—

(a) carries out the self-employment activity as specified in item 1 of the

First Schedule to the Act;

(b) holds a valid driving licence issued under section 26 of the

Road Transport Act 1987 [Act 333]; and

(c) for the purposes of paragraph (a), has been issued with—

(i) a valid vocational licence under section 56 of the Road Transport

Act 1987 by a Director for Road Transport; and

(ii) a valid driver's card or electronic driver's card under rule 10A of

the Motor Vehicles (Commercial Transport) Rules 1959

[L.N. 175/1959] by the Suruhanjaya Pengangkutan Awam Darat or

Commercial Vehicles Licencing Board.

Rates of contribution

3. (1) Every e-hailing vehicle driver shall pay a contribution to the Organization

or any self-employment social security agent at the rates as selected by the e-hailing

vehicle driver based on the Selected Insured Monthly Earning as specified

in the Schedule.

(2) The coverage period for the rates of contribution selected by the e-hailing

vehicle driver under subregulation (1) shall be for a period of twelve

consecutive months.

(3) If within the coverage period referred to in subregulation (2) the validity

of the vocational licence issued to the e-hailing vehicle driver under section 56 of the

Road Transport Act 1987, or the driver's card or electronic driver's card issued to the

e-hailing vehicle driver under rule 10A of the Motor Vehicles (Commercial Transport)

Rules 1959, expires—

(a) the coverage period shall continue to have effect until the period of twelve

consecutive months expires; and

(b) the e-hailing vehicle driver shall submit to the Organization, upon request

by the Organization, his new vocational licence, driver's card or electronic

driver's card, as the case may be, for verification.
